implementation_strategy: Hosted-model API calls to gpt-5-mini for LLM-conditioned guarded generation; deterministic template baseline produced locally; deterministic parser+translator maps LLM output to verifier input; verifier (Dockerized Batfish) runs locally in CPU Docker container; all scoring deterministic and automated; no human labour or external partners.
public_resources: Public Git repo with task JSON, transformation code, parser, verifier input, unit tests, and raw outputs (to be published)
Docker image reference for pinned Batfish verifier
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (hosted API; single model used for confirmatory claim)
task_manifest_strategy: Programmatic synthesis of 120 intent→config tasks (40 per topology class) with pre-inclusion unit tests; automatic replacement of any task failing gold-template unit tests prior to model calls.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Publish deterministic intent→gold-template generator, grammar-based LLM-output parser with parse-failure flags, and verifier-input mappers; include pytest suite and CI-style Docker runs reproducing mapping tests.
execution_batches: Batch 1: validate task unit tests and generate gold baselines (local CPU Docker CI)
Batch 2: call hosted gpt-5-mini for guarded generation seed_0 (120 calls)
Batch 3: run verifier on all LLM outputs and baseline outputs (Docker Batfish)
Batch 4: (automatic) conditional repair calls up to 1 per task only when initial LLM candidate fails deterministic validation (at most 120 additional calls)
randomisation_plan: Task selection pre-specified and deterministic (programmatic sampling with fixed seed); no randomisation across confirmatory seed (seed_0 fixed).
caching_plan: Cache all hosted-model responses and verifier logs; reuse cached responses for deterministic reruns; store hashes for all artifacts in public repo.
failure_recovery_plan: Automatic retries for infrastructure failures up to 2 automatic retries per failed call (per preregistration). If >10% confirmatory pairs excluded after retries, abort per stopping rule and report incomplete run.
result_schema: Per-episode JSON following paired_binary_episode_v1: includes task_id, baseline_verifier_pass (0/1), llm_verifier_pass_seed0 (0/1), parse_fail_flag, contamination_flags, raw_llm_output, verifier_logs, timestamps, and artifact hashes.
estimated_compute_notes: Expected hosted-model calls: 120 (one initial generation per task). Up to 120 additional repair calls possible (max 240). Verifier runs executed in local Docker containers (CPU-only) using pinned Batfish; compute and wall-clock within manifest limits (≤7 days).
